tablet_inception.hint.release: Right Ctrl: release mouse and keyboard
tablet_inception.hint.app: Click the screen to take control  |  Esc: close the tablet
tablet_inception.hint.scute: Type and press Enter  |  Mouse wheel: scroll  |  Esc: back
tablet_inception.hint.settings: Choose options with the mouse  |  Esc: back
tablet_inception.hint.weather: Mouse wheel: scroll the comments  |  Esc: back
tablet_inception.hint.notes: Type to take notes (saves automatically)  |  Ctrl+V: paste  |  Esc: back
tablet_inception.hint.music: Click a track to play  |  Mouse wheel: scroll  |  Esc: back
tablet_inception.hint.home: Tap an app to open it  |  Esc: close the tablet
tablet_inception.settings.color_help: Click a color to apply it. The square with an x restores the default color.
tablet_inception.settings.tip: Tip: drag an image (png, jpg, bmp, gif) from your PC onto this screen.
tablet_inception.settings.picker_unavail: File picker unavailable. Drag the image onto this screen.
tablet_inception.child.first_time: It may take a minute the first time.
tablet_inception.scute.greeting: Hello! I'm ScuteAI. Ask me something or type 'help'.
tablet_inception.weather.no_world: I couldn't reach the world right now. Try again in a moment.
tablet_inception.weather.nether1: There's no sun, rain or night here: just heat, lava and fire.
tablet_inception.weather.nether2: Don't sleep here: the bed explodes!
tablet_inception.weather.nether3: The Overworld weather can't be seen from here. Go back to the surface to check it.
tablet_inception.weather.end1: The End has no weather, day or night: only the void and the Dragon.
tablet_inception.weather.end2: Beds explode here too. Don't even try to sleep.
tablet_inception.weather.end3: Watch out for Endermen and for falling into the void.
tablet_inception.weather.clear_night1: The sky is clear and starry, but it's monster time. Stay close to shelter.
tablet_inception.weather.can_sleep: You can already sleep to skip the night.
tablet_inception.weather.can_sleep_soon: You'll be able to sleep soon.
tablet_inception.weather.full_moon: Full moon: the night is brighter than usual.
tablet_inception.weather.new_moon: New moon: the night is very dark. Bring torches.
tablet_inception.weather.dawn1: The sun is rising and the sky is clear. Great start to the day!
tablet_inception.weather.dawn2: The night monsters are starting to vanish. It's safe to leave shelter.
tablet_inception.weather.dusk1: The sky is clear, but the sun is setting. Find shelter.
tablet_inception.weather.dusk2: Light some torches: monsters will start appearing soon.
tablet_inception.weather.sunny1: Clear sky with no heavy clouds. The weather is great!
tablet_inception.weather.sunny2: A good time to explore, build or farm on the surface.
tablet_inception.weather.sunny3: Zombies and skeletons burn in the sun. Creepers and spiders are still around.
tablet_inception.weather.dry: Dry biome: it never rains or snows here.
tablet_inception.weather.cold: Cold biome: when the weather turns, it will snow instead of rain.
tablet_inception.weather.rain1: The sky is overcast and it's raining. Bad weather for a stroll.
tablet_inception.weather.rain2: The rain is just starting and will get stronger.
tablet_inception.weather.rain3: The rain is easing. The weather should clear up soon.
tablet_inception.weather.rain4: Rain puts out fires and waters crops by itself.
tablet_inception.weather.rain_night: Rain at night: low visibility and monsters on the loose. Stay alert!
tablet_inception.weather.rain_day: In the rain, zombies and skeletons don't burn in the sun, even by day.
tablet_inception.weather.rain_roof: You're under a roof, so the rain can't reach you.
tablet_inception.weather.rain_open: You're outdoors, but rain doesn't cause damage.
tablet_inception.weather.snow1: It's snowing here: everything turns white and pretty, but it's cold.
tablet_inception.weather.snow2: Powder snow is a trap: you sink and freeze. Wear leather boots.
tablet_inception.weather.snow3: Strays appear in these biomes and shoot slowness arrows.
tablet_inception.weather.snow4: Water freezes and snow piles up on the ground.
tablet_inception.weather.snow_roof: You're under a roof, protected from the snow.
tablet_inception.weather.snow_open: You're outdoors: bring food and torches.
tablet_inception.weather.overcast1: It's raining in the world, but this biome is dry: the sky closes in and not a drop falls.
tablet_inception.weather.overcast2: Even so, zombies and skeletons don't burn under overcast skies.
tablet_inception.weather.overcast3: To see real rain, head to a plains or forest.
tablet_inception.weather.overcast4: There's thunder in the world. Lightning can strike in other biomes.
tablet_inception.weather.thunder1: Thunderstorm! Lightning can strike at any moment.
tablet_inception.weather.thunder2: Avoid open fields, hills and tower tops: lightning hits the highest point.
tablet_inception.weather.thunder3: Lightning sets wood on fire, creates charged creepers and turns villagers into witches.
tablet_inception.weather.thunder4: Beware of lone horses: thunderstorms can create skeleton traps.
tablet_inception.weather.thunder5: You can sleep now: sleeping ends the storm.
tablet_inception.weather.thunder_open: You're exposed to the sky: find shelter!
tablet_inception.weather.underground: You're underground (Y %s): the weather outside doesn't affect caves.
